Keep secrets, personal information and private Project data out of this report. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerability reports; do not include them in public issues.

Planning type does not assign a Story Map level or a native GitHub Issue type.

## User story

Explain who needs what outcome and why. Keep it small enough to deliver and review independently.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable conditions that must hold for this User Story to be accepted.

## Context and references (optional)

Add relevant examples, dependencies, related planning items and source links.
